description: DEV ONLY. Lets a locally served Duct app (Next dev server) call the shell commands from a built dev bundle, where localhost is a remote origin rather than a devUrl. Release builds must exclude this: tauri.conf.json pins app.security.capabilities to ["default"], and only tauri.dev.conf.json opts this back in. The port is wildcarded because URLPattern matching on an explicit port does not match reliably. The `notification:*` entries are not for our own code, which notifies through the `notify` command: registering `tauri-plugin-notification` injects a `window.Notification` polyfill into every webview, and that polyfill invokes `is_permission_granted` on load. Without these it was denied, and the rejection surfaced as a runtime error on every page load.
